Home.heroSubtitle: Premium furniture, FF&E procurement, interior design, and project management for luxury spaces worldwide.
Home.philosophyText: GENESI is your partner for high-end interior solutions. From bespoke furniture to complete turnkey contract management, we bring Italian design excellence to hotels, residences, and commercial spaces. Every detail is meticulously engineered to ensure timeless elegance.
Home.turnkeyText: We provide comprehensive FF&E procurement, custom millwork, and project management. From the initial concept to the final white-glove installation, Genesi ensures impeccable execution.

About.heroSubtitle: Rooted in the timeless tradition of Italian craftsmanship, GENESI redefines luxury living through innovative design and impeccable execution.
About.storyP1: Since our inception, GENESI has been driven by a singular vision: to create environments that inspire. We believe that true luxury lies in the harmony between aesthetics and functionality, where every line, every material, and every finish tells a story.
About.storyP2: Our approach combines the soul of artisan craftsmanship with the precision of modern engineering. From our headquarters in Milan, we curate collections and orchestrate bespoke contract projects for the world's most demanding clients.
About.statMadeInItalyDesc: Sourced, crafted, and finished entirely in Italy by master artisans.
About.statGlobalProjectsDesc: Delivering turnkey FF&E solutions across five continents.
About.statBespokeOptionsDesc: Infinite customization possibilities to meet any architectural vision.

Studio.heroSubtitle: Our internal creative hub where architecture, interior design, and product engineering converge.
Studio.hubP1: GENESI Studio is the beating heart of our brand. Composed of architects, interior designers, and master engineers, the studio is responsible for the conception of our collections and the execution of our turnkey contract projects.
Studio.hubP2: By maintaining a seamless dialogue between the drawing board and the production floor, we ensure that every design is not only conceptually striking but also structurally impeccable and perfectly tailored to the client's needs.
Studio.quote: Design is not just what it looks like and feels like. Design is how it works within the space.

Services.headerSubtitle: From concept engineering to flawless execution, GENESI offers a comprehensive suite of services tailored for the most demanding luxury projects worldwide.
Services.readySubtitle: Our team of contract specialists is ready to review your architectural plans and provide a comprehensive quotation.
Services.s01Desc: Every space is unique, and so are its requirements. Our master artisans and in-house design team collaborate closely with architects to customize our collections or engineer completely bespoke pieces from scratch, ensuring perfect integration into your architectural vision.
Services.s02Desc: We manage the complexities of global luxury procurement. From selecting the finest Furniture, Fixtures, and Equipment to managing vendor relations and quality control, GENESI acts as your single point of contact for outfitting world-class hospitality and residential projects.
Services.s03Desc: Our turnkey service provides peace of mind for large-scale developments. We oversee the entire lifecycle of the interior outfitting process, transforming bare architectural shells into fully operational, breathtaking environments, delivered on time and flawlessly executed.
Services.s04Desc: The final touch of luxury. Our dedicated logistics team ensures that every piece of furniture is transported under the strictest safety conditions and installed on-site by our specialized technicians with meticulous care and precision.

Materials.headerSubtitle: The essence of true luxury lies in what you can feel. At GENESI, we obsess over every surface, sourcing only the most exquisite materials to craft masterpieces that stand the test of time.
Materials.sampleSubtitle: Architects and interior designers can request our exclusive Materials Box to experience the GENESI quality firsthand.
Materials.marblesDesc: Sourced from the finest quarries in Carrara and around the world, our marbles offer unparalleled unique veining and timeless elegance. Each slab is hand-selected by our master artisans.
Materials.woodsDesc: We use only sustainably sourced, premium timber. Our veneers are carefully book-matched to create seamless, continuous grain patterns that celebrate the natural beauty of the wood.
Materials.metalsDesc: Our metal components undergo rigorous galvanic treatments to achieve flawless, durable finishes that range from warm, brushed brass to sleek, polished chrome.
Materials.leathersDesc: Working exclusively with top-tier Italian tanneries, we offer full-grain leathers and nabuk that age beautifully, providing unparalleled softness and durability.

Contact.headerSubtitle: Whether you are inquiring about a specific collection, requesting a bespoke piece, or proposing a large-scale hospitality project, our team is at your disposal.
Contact.tradePressDesc: For press inquiries or to join our trade program, please direct your correspondence to

Vela.metaTitle: VELA by Genesi — Doors & Surfaces for Interior Architecture
Vela.metaDescription: VELA by Genesi collection: high-end residential interior doors, hotel doors, and shower enclosures.
Vela.claim: Doors and surfaces for interior architecture.
Vela.ourFamiliesDesc: Three coordinated expressions conceived to define transitions, safeguard privacy, and elevate spatial balance.
Vela.inPreparationDesc: Technical documentation and sample boxes for this collection are currently being engineered for bespoke contract orders.
Vela.allProductsDesc: Rigorous flush alignment, fluid kinematics, and Italian craftsmanship in both aesthetic and mechanical details.
Vela.noProductsFound: No systems found matching the selected type.
Vela.materialsSubtitle: Mechanical precision designed to merge seamlessly into the wall or express a crisp architectural accent.
Vela.detailPivotsDesc: Fluid, dampened rotation with no visible hinges on the door face.
Vela.detailTracksDesc: Calibrated carriages and threshold-free flooring for continuous spatial flow.
Vela.detailFlushDesc: Flawless integration with plasterboard, timber panelling, or architectural stone.
Vela.contactSubtitle: Our contract specialists are available for architects, interior designers, and developers for technical sheets, material samples, and feasibility assessments.
Vela.verifiedNotesDesc: Dimensions, veneers, and surface finishes are custom-tailored to specification for each architectural project.
Vela.heroAlt: VELA by Genesi — Doors and surfaces for interior architecture
Vela.editorialTitle: Geometries of transition, coplanarity and textural silence.
Vela.editorialText: The door is no longer a partition element, but a continuous architectural plane. VELA was born within the GENESI universe to offer designers integrated entrance systems: from theatrical pivot doors to seamless flush-sliding systems.
Vela.hardwareSpotlightTitle: VELA Handles, Recessed Pulls & Electronic Locks
Vela.hardwareSpotlightDesc: The tactile interface of the door system. Hand-forged handles, long pulls for glass and fluted wood, solid-milled flush finger grips, and RFID hospitality locks.
Vela.altDetailGola: Milled Grip Detail in Solid Wood
Vela.interiorMetaTitle: Residential Interior Doors — VELA by Genesi
Vela.interiorMetaDesc: Interior door systems: flush-to-wall alignment, concealed pivot hinges, pocket sliding doors, fluted glass, and full-height bespoke swing doors.
Vela.interiorHeroSubtitle: Wall-flush coplanarity, concealed pivot rotation, pocket sliding systems, ribbed glass, and full-height ceiling-flush leaves without transom.
Vela.interiorCatalogTitle: Interior Door Collection: Pivot, Sliding, and Swing
Vela.interiorCatalogDesc: Filter the collection by motion type and discover models in natural oak, canaletto walnut, matte lacquers, and fluted art glass.
Vela.interiorCraftTitle: The details that define VELA excellence
Vela.interiorCraftDesc: From 5-axis solid wood milling to 3D adjustable concealed hinges: superior craftsmanship is tangible in every millimeter.
Vela.interiorBespokeTitle: Every system is custom-engineered for your interior project.
Vela.interiorBespokeDesc: VELA interior doors adapt to floor-to-ceiling heights, wall typologies (drywall or flush plaster), and bespoke interior finishes.
Vela.hotelMetaTitle: Hotel Room Doors — VELA by Genesi
Vela.hotelMetaDesc: Luxury hospitality door systems: hallway boiserie coplanarity, certified acoustic insulation, and seamless RFID access control integration.
Vela.hotelHeroSubtitle: Coordinated high-end hospitality solutions combining the rigorous aesthetics of Italian design with the demanding technical standards of international luxury hotels.
Vela.hotelEditorialTitle: The suite entrance threshold: architectural continuity and acoustic sanctuary.
Vela.hotelEditorialDesc: In prestigious hotel architecture, the guestroom door shapes the guest's initial impression and guards their private sanctuary. VELA designs entrance systems flawlessly coordinated with GENESI FF&E and boiserie panelling, ensuring a turnkey contract delivery from concept to site installation.
Vela.hotelPillarsTitle: The technical pillars of the VELA hospitality line
Vela.hotelPillar1Desc: Engineered to deliver undisturbed guest rest through soft-compression acoustic perimeter seals and concealed automatic drop-down door bottoms.
Vela.hotelPillar2Desc: Seamless flush mortise preparation for hospitality industry-standard electronic and magnetic locks (RFID / Smart Key), preserving the door face's minimalist purity.
Vela.hotelPillar3Desc: Flush-to-wall architectural solutions connecting continuously with wood panelling or lacquered wall claddings across hotel corridors.
Vela.hotelPillar4Desc: Wide spectrum of certified veneers, heavy-duty scratch-resistant lacquers, and coordinated architectural metals engineered for international contract tenders.
Vela.hotelDetailsTitle: Excellence in details: RFID locks, hinges, and precise reveals
Vela.hotelDetailsDesc: In hospitality projects, technical hardware is never secondary: every rebate, magnetic strike, and electronic component is engineered for silent operation and decades of heavy traffic.
Vela.hotelHardwareBannerTitle: VELA Handles, Pulls & Electronic Locking Collection
Vela.hotelHardwareBannerDesc: Discover the full range of forged levers, glass pulls, flush finger channels, and silent magnetic locks designed to coordinate with our hotel doors.
Vela.showerMetaTitle: Glass Shower Enclosures & Partitions — VELA by Genesi
Vela.showerMetaDesc: Shower enclosure systems and glass architectural partitions: minimal flush profiles, 8/10 mm tempered safety glass, pivot kinematics, and CleanGlass coating.
Vela.showerHeroDesc: Pure architectural transparency and rigorous geometries for contemporary wellness. 8 and 10 mm tempered safety glass, flush profiles, and concealed watertight seals.
Vela.showerSectionDesc: 23 modular series for luxury wellness spaces. Flush pivot mechanisms, magnetic sliding kinematics, and walk-in screens crafted in 8 and 10 mm tempered glass with permanent CleanGlass treatment.

Vela.showerCleanGlassDesc: Permanent thermal hydrophobic molecular coating preventing limescale accumulation and enabling effortless cleaning.
Vela.handlesMetaTitle: Handles, Smart Locks & Architectural Hardware — VELA by Genesi
Vela.handlesMetaDesc: Door handle collection, Simonswerk 3D concealed hinges, AGB magnetic locks, biometric smart locks, and RFID hotel card readers.
Vela.handlesHeroSubtitle: The tactile and engineering interface of the door system: 3D concealed hinges, silent magnetic locks, biometric smart access, and hotel RFID transponders.
Vela.handlesEditorialTitle: The true quality of a door is revealed the moment you touch and operate it.
Vela.handlesEditorialDesc: In VELA, the lever, concealed hinges, and latching components are not mere accessories, but foundational elements of the architectural door design. European noble metals and certified mechanisms deliver effortless motion, razor-sharp coplanarity, and absolute quiet upon closing.
Vela.handlesModelsTitle: VELA coordinated handles and grip systems
Vela.hardwareSectionHeaderTag: Engineering & Access Control • VELA Hardware Program
Vela.hardwareSectionHeaderDesc: Rigorous curation of premium European engineering: Simonswerk 3D adjustable concealed hinges, whisper-quiet AGB magnetic mortise locks, ISEO electronic cylinders, ekey biometric scanners, and ASSA ABLOY VingCard hospitality systems.
